pages.text: The Abilities of the $(l:armors/sinner_robes)$(c)$(o)Sinner's Robe$() Boots are primarily mobility oriented: A $(l:tools/light_devourer)$(c)$(o)Light Devourer$() will allow the wearer to directly walk on Darkness by crouching. This includes both naturally occurring shade and the artificial Darkness placed by a Light Devourer.
